e1901ee5c668677b.column_purpose: Total number of ballots cast in that year's vote by that voting body; the denominator for vote share.

6a104613a01d4ab2.column_purpose: The role in which the person was considered: Player, Manager, Umpire, or Pioneer/Executive.

11669ced7d028eb1.column_purpose: Whether the candidate was inducted into the Hall of Fame as a result of that vote (Y/N).

93da83d0d87d25f2.column_purpose: Number of votes required for induction in that election (typically 75% of ballots cast).

f5cdb9df6e8016c9.column_purpose: Annotation about the vote threshold context, e.g. '1st' (first-year/primary ballot) or 'Top 20' (runoff/nominating vote); empty for normal BBWAA ballots. Alternative reading: it may flag how the 'needed' threshold was derived for non-standard elections rather than the ballot round itself.

f7b51b375354f993.column_purpose: Identifier of the person under consideration; references player.player_id (covers players, managers, umpires, executives).

5e0dcce42867d822.column_purpose: Voting body or election type: BBWAA (Baseball Writers' Association of America), Veterans Committee, Run Off, Nominating Vote, Old Timers, Special Election, Negro League, Final Ballot, etc.

c412fd9c59749347.column_purpose: Number of votes the candidate received in that election.

6653840cff196873.column_purpose: Year of the Hall of Fame election (1936–2016).

7b1f4b75c0ac6be2.column_purpose: City where the player was born.

e2a7766525b1e73f.column_purpose: Country of birth; mostly standardized codes (USA, CAN, D.R., P.R.) with some full names (Cuba, Venezuela, Switzerland).

d08e9387d422bc3a.column_purpose: Day-of-month component of the birth date (1-31).

8e2d65ce0f6df7ab.column_purpose: Month component of the birth date (1-12); empty string when unknown.

011464579ef58cb3.column_purpose: State/province of birth, mostly US state codes (CA, PA, NY); some non-US values present (e.g. Holguin, Worcestershire), so data quality is mixed.

22ebd61bdbbf8c5b.column_purpose: City where the player died; empty string for living players.

d99951181dafd8c1.column_purpose: Country of death; empty string for living players.

f5ad44e05080e8d5.column_purpose: Day-of-month component of death date; empty string for living players.

b026f6828fe1d065.column_purpose: Month component of death date; empty string for living players.

d38c292189a82ac8.column_purpose: State/province of death (US state codes); empty string for living players.

5fa376d3f1938066.column_purpose: Year of death (1872-2016); empty string for living players.

9d317e025344e884.column_purpose: Player's commonly used first name or nickname (e.g. 'Sugar', 'Happy').

79d37341051e30d3.column_purpose: Player's full given (legal) name, may include middle names.

bcc881288fa57552.column_purpose: Primary key; unique player identifier in lastname+firstname+sequence format (e.g. aaronha01). Referenced by hall_of_fame, player_award, player_award_vote, and salary.

de86376beaaf4685.column_purpose: Name of the award won (e.g., Most Valuable Player, Gold Glove, Silver Slugger, TSN All-Star, Baseball Magazine All-Star, NLCS MVP, Pitching Triple Crown).

a1ad3cc6848da621.column_purpose: League in which the award was won: AL = American League, NL = National League, ML = Major League Baseball (both leagues / overall), AA = American Association (19th century).

030643183db4c6d4.column_purpose: Supplementary detail about the award, most often the position played (OF, SS, 3B, 1B, RF, DH), sometimes handedness (LHP) or game number (e.g., '1st Game', 'P4' for All-Star Game pitcher).

ec8ea5abe727f55f.column_purpose: Identifier of the player who won the award; references player.player_id (e.g., bondsba01 = Barry Bonds).

4b1021105f523105.column_purpose: Whether the award was shared/tied with another player: 'Y' if tied, empty otherwise.

960d9a0019360313.column_purpose: Season/year in which the award was won, 1877-2015.

5eecaea0238d9c2e.column_purpose: Name of the award being voted on: MVP (most valuable player), Cy Young (best pitcher), Rookie of the Year.

cb11d5830baa9c53.column_purpose: League in which the award was voted: AL (American League), NL (National League), ML (major leagues, pre-split/combined voting, e.g. early MVP).

6fa5436c3b527f27.column_purpose: Identifier of the player who received votes; references player.player_id (many votes to one player).

559df7022c01131e.column_purpose: Total points available in that year's voting (e.g. 336 = 14 voters x 24 points for MVP); the winner's points_won equals this value.

615f16ea574cc4bd.column_purpose: Voting points the player received in that award vote; 0 to points_max.

96b9230748412177.column_purpose: Number of first-place votes the player received; empty string means unknown/not recorded (358 rows), otherwise 0-32.

81112f597dbf7662.column_purpose: Baseball league the player's team belonged to that season: 'NL' = National League, 'AL' = American League.

2ed8bf0758c00ddc.column_purpose: Identifier of the player, referencing player.player_id (many-to-one). Encoded as lastname + first initials + sequence number (e.g. moyerja01 = Jamie Moyer).

23953fbfa41b3740.column_purpose: The player's salary for that season, in US dollars (whole dollars; range 0 to 33,000,000, median 550,000).

17074c60ed8df134.column_purpose: Franchise/team code the player was paid by that season (e.g. CLE Cleveland, LAN Los Angeles Dodgers, NYA New York Yankees, MON Montreal Expos). No join target exists in this database, so the exact team lookup is unavailable.

e2f085b29cf4ce12.column_purpose: Season year the salary applies to, 1985-2015.
